entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri R.K. Sharma, learned senior counsel with Ms. Neha Malaliya, counsel for the applicant.
Shri Aditya Singh, Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State.
Case Diary is perused.
Learned counsel for the rival parties are heard.
This is first application under section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

The applicant apprehends his arrest in connection with Crime No.382/2019 registered at Police Station- Ambah, District- Morena for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 272, 273 and 120- B of IPC and Sections 51 and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

Allegations against the applicant, in short, are that applicant along with co-accused was found involved in manufacturing food unsafe for human consumption at Milk Chiller Center of the co- accused, wherefrom two tankers containing 12000 litres of milk and a loading vehicle carrying 2 15 sacks of Exetrin powder were seized.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has been falsely implicated.
He is neither the owner of the Tankers nor of the business.
The offences are triable by JMFC.
Except section 420 of the IPC and 51 and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, the rest are bailable in nature.
There is no allegation of cheating against the applicant.
Nothing has been seized from the applicant.
There is no likelihood of his absconsion or tampering with the evidence.

With the aforesaid submissions,
prayer for anticipatory bail is made.

Learned Public Prosecutor for the State opposed the HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH (Banwarilal Sharma Vs. State of M.P.) application and prayed for its rejection by contending that on the basis of the allegations and the material available on record, no case for grant of anticipatory bail is made out.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH (Banwarilal Sharma Vs. State of M.P.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is also submitted by the learned counsel for the respondent/State that the investigation is pending and custodial interrogation may be required in the matter.

sentences.text: After considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties and circumstances of the case, without expressing any view on the merits of the matter, it is not a good case in which the applicant may be released on anticipatory bail.
Consequently, this anticipatory bail application under Section 438 of Cr.P.C filed by the applicant is hereby dismissed .
Certified copy as per rules.
